ASBSkill.description: Collection-time aggregated skill record — the deduplicated, paper-grounded scientific competency surfaced by ``corpus_artifacts.collect_skills`` at release time. Distinct from ``SkillBundle`` which is the per-capsule artifact. Mirrors the Python dataclass at agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBSkill (formerly SciSkill).

bundle_dir.description: Absolute path to the offline skill knowledge base bundle directory

description.description: Retrieval-key description for an ASBSkill. Discipline-constrained: 50–300 chars, leads with "Use when …", no marketing tokens. The CI gate in asb-skill-collections additionally enforces the banned-token list at release time.

edam_operation.description: Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799)

edam_topics.description: EDAM topic IRIs for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/topic_3172)

kb_path.description: Relative path to the skill's knowledge-base entry file

merged_alias_records.description: Per-merge audit records documenting alias deduplication decisions

merged_aliases.description: Original labels of skills merged into this canonical entry

related_tools.description: Canonical URLs / slugs of tools used by this skill

skill_name.description: Human-readable canonical name of the skill

slug.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated unique identifier for this skill bundle (e.g. spectral-similarity-scoring)

source_paper_doi.description: Primary source paper DOI (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_paper_title.description: Primary source paper title (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_papers.description: Structured references to papers that contributed to this bundle

source_task_ids.description: task_id values of the ASB task cards from which this skill was extracted

when_to_use.description: Guidance on when and how to apply this skill

ASBSkill.title: ASBSkill

ASBTool.description: Collection-time aggregated tool record — the deduplicated, paper-grounded software-tool reference surfaced by ``corpus_artifacts.collect_tools``. Mirrors the Python dataclass at agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBTool (formerly SciTool).

bio_tools_id.description: bio.tools identifier for this tool. Reserved slot for the future bio.tools federation work; not populated in v1.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL for the tool (GitHub, bio.tools, PyPI, etc.)

edam_operation.description: Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799)

edam_topics.description: EDAM topic IRIs for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/topic_3172)

evidence_spans.description: Verbatim quotes from source papers anchoring this tool reference

install.description: Install metadata dict (conda / pip / docker / etc.) produced by tool_resolver

related_skills.description: Slugs of ASBSkill records that reference this tool

resolution_attempts.description: Audit list of resolver attempts (each entry a dict; serialized as JSON)

slug.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated unique identifier for this skill bundle (e.g. spectral-similarity-scoring)

source_paper_doi.description: Primary source paper DOI (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_paper_title.description: Primary source paper title (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_task_ids.description: task_id values of the ASB task cards from which this skill was extracted

tool_name.description: Tool name (mirrors ToolRecord.tool_name; used by ASBTool)

version_used.description: Version string actually used in the source paper(s)

ASBTool.title: ASBTool

MergeAuditRecord.description: Per-merge audit record documenting alias deduplication decisions. Surfaces the data ``corpus_artifacts._semantic_dedup`` already records so dedup decisions are queryable and citable.

decided_at.description: When the merge decision was recorded (ISO 8601)

decided_by.description: Agent or person that made the decision (e.g. "agent:dedup", "orcid:0000-...")

edam_match.description: True when both records share an EDAM operation IRI

embedding_cosine.description: Cosine similarity of MiniLM embeddings (when semantic dedup ran)

jaccard_score.description: Token-set Jaccard similarity score used for the merge decision

llm_judge_verdict.description: Free-form judgement string from an LLM dedup judge (if used)

target_slug.description: Canonical slug this alias was merged into

MergeAuditRecord.title: MergeAuditRecord

MergeDecisionEnum.description: Possible outcomes recorded by a MergeAuditRecord
MergeDecisionEnum.title: MergeDecisionEnum

PaperReference.description: A reference to a source paper that contributed to this skill bundle.

relevance.description: Short note on the relevance of this paper to the skill

task_ids.description: task_id values from this paper that surfaced this skill

ToolAffordance.description: W3C WoT ActionAffordance-aligned mixin. RESERVED for v1 — slot definitions exist but no ASB class consumes them yet. When the ecosystem standardises on WoT for executable tools, ASBTool (or an ExecutableTool subclass) will inherit from this mixin without breaking existing instances.

effect.description: Free-form effect description for downstream agents

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input payload (WoT ActionAffordance.input)

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's output payload (WoT ActionAffordance.output)

precondition.description: Free-form precondition (e.g. "requires CUDA 12.x") — WoT-style affordance hint

side_effect_free.description: True when invoking the tool has no observable side effects (pure function)
